audience: shops and restaurants who send same-day courier deliveries with Stuart

useCases.title: Get a price quote and courier ETA before booking
useCases.text: The AI prices a delivery from a pickup address to a dropoff address for a package type, and estimates the seconds until a courier arrives. Nothing is booked.

useCases.title: Check if addresses are covered and valid
useCases.text: The AI checks that a job would be accepted and that an address lies inside a Stuart zone. It can also read a zone's coverage area and scheduling slots.

useCases.title: Follow deliveries that are in progress
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs of the last 90 days filtered by status, with tracking URLs, driver and proof of delivery, and gets the courier's anonymous phone number.

useCases.title: Book a delivery and tell Stuart it is ready
useCases.text: The AI creates a job with one pickup and up to 8 dropoffs, which dispatches a courier, and signals that the order is packed. The job is charged.

useCases.title: Update or cancel a delivery
useCases.text: The AI changes the reference, package description or contact details of a delivery, or cancels a whole job or one delivery. A fee may apply.
